ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels estimated at 75% of surface area, with a concentrated high-intensity (white) region occupying approximately 25% of the visible ventral area primarily on the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region on the left lobe distal tip extending toward the notch, containing dark mottling. Right lobe is predominantly low-intensity with sparse white mottling near the trailing edge. High-intensity rosette clusters are present at both lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile along the trailing edge characterized by high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations forming a jagged saw-tooth boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outward sweep on both lobes; left lobe tip exhibits a more pronounced upward vertical trajectory than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of circular, high-contrast yellowish-white pixels localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and along the right lobe trailing edge, consistent with sessile barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear rake marks observed on the dark pigmentation; three prominent vertical marks on the right lobe and several shorter diagonal marks on the central-left fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization concentrated on fluke extremities; minor tissue irregularities/notches on the far left lobe tip trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black-on-white mottling pattern within the primary white patch on the left lobe distal region.
